def ballpos(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    p=[(i,j) for i in range(10,63) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='p']
    if not p: return None
    r=[x[0] for x in p]; c=[x[1] for x in p]
    return (min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c))
def timer(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); return sum(1 for ch in a[63] if ch=='W')
